notes: Two factor codes. Pin and version from the build installed from Play (7.2, versionCode 7002011), signed with Play App Signing (CN=Android, O=Google Inc.). No policy, so it is fully open inside the tunnel, by choice. The codes themselves are computed on the device and need no network; the network is for backing the accounts up to the Google account and restoring them. Available from NAVIGATION_ONLY because a device in the strictest modes still has to sign in to things, and it shows nothing but codes.
